calculation.expression: mom20 * breadth_state when mean rolling20 cross-sectional volatility >= trailing120 median, otherwise 0.25*mom20; breadth_state=+1 if lagged 60d positive-return breadth >=0.55, -1 if <=0.45, else 0
calculation.description: A lagged 20-day cross-asset trend signal whose direction is conditioned on broad market breadth and whose strength is confirmed by elevated dispersion. Neutral breadth produces zero in high-dispersion conditions and a small trend carry-through otherwise. All inputs are lagged to prevent look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in 2020-2029 overall, strongest 2024-2026; negative in 2030-2034, so recent drift requires monitoring.
validation.provenance: Computed on 15 tradable benchmark instruments; each IC date required at least 8 valid instruments; forward returns use 10 trading days and factor inputs are shifted one completed day.
